scope: Close the exact-source discovery stage for the sole missing canonical BNR Bank Lending Survey realised round, 2025-Q2, without manufacturing workbook URLs, substituting rounded publication text for exact workbook cells, treating search non-discovery as source absence, or opening calibration.

discovery_channels.finding: Targeted public/indexed searches around the exact official publication slug, publication date, title variants, XLS/XLSX file types and known BNR BLS naming conventions did not expose an exact official 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint. This is non-discovery, not evidence that the workbook never existed.

BNR's historical survey page states that questionnaire results are available as time series. The current public crawl/search surface does not expose the exact historical target behind that time-series reference, so no file or dataset may be promoted from it.
The current BNR survey surface is confirmed, but the audited public crawl/search representation does not expose an exact machine-readable 2025-Q2 annex target.

No alternative official source was identified that supplies the same six realised BNR survey observables for 2025-Q2 at exact workbook precision and the same survey boundary. Different surveys, populations or frequencies are not substitutes.

exhaustion_assessment.reason: All admissible public-discovery paths available in this pass either confirm the official report/survey surface without yielding the exact machine-readable 2025-Q2 target or yield no definitionally equivalent official substitute. Repeating the same indexed queries cannot improve exact-source identity without new provider-side evidence.

reopen_triggers: BNR exposes the exact official XLS/XLSX annex URL for the 2025-Q2 Bank Lending Survey round through its current page, archive, search or another official link surface.

BNR exposes a stable official time-series file, dataset or series identifier that contains the six preregistered realised observables for 2025-Q2 at sufficient precision and with matching survey semantics.
An official BNR archive or preserved official-page target resolves the historical time-series link to a reproducible machine-readable source with the required semantics.
BNR publishes a replacement machine-readable BLS catalogue, export or API that establishes the exact 2025-Q2 values and definitions.
non_reopen_conditions: Repeating the same search-engine queries without a new official clue.
Guessing BNR upload filenames, file-type suffixes, timestamps, directory paths or internal endpoints.
Using rounded narrative/report values as exact workbook-cell replacements.
Using a third-party reproduction as canonical evidence.
Using a different survey, population, frequency or semantic variable merely because its values appear similar.
